title: Learning Statistics with R-Instat
description: A book in progress on R-Instat, a free point-and-click statistics package built on R. The first three chapters are available so far. Chapter 1 introduces R-Instat and its dialogs by importing and exploring a cassava dataset, with factors (categorical columns) as a key idea. Chapter 2 practises working with real experimental and survey data: inspecting, checking, correcting, reshaping, labelling and transforming it, then exploring with pivot tables and graphs. Chapter 3 bridges from menus to code, moving from the calculator and other halfway dialogs to viewing, running and adapting R scripts from the R-Instat script library.
